color.note: Material 3 roles. Light and Dark are the brand fallback (deep green, seed #1B5E45) used when dynamic colour is off or unavailable. The two Dynamic sample themes show the same roles generated from a wallpaper: every M3 role moves, status-*, storage-low and brand-* never do.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Key actions: filled buttons, the active switch track, progress fill, selected nav indicator icon.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal emphasis: the FAB, selected sync-mode card, the onboarding promise panel. In the brand themes this is the brand deep green itself.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside a snackbar (on inverse-surface).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quieter accents: focus ring, selected chip outline, secondary icons that carry meaning.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Selected filter chips, the navigation-bar active indicator, tonal buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: The Drive side of a pair: Drive icons and the Drive end of a path row. Never a status.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Drive-side tinted chips and the Drive account avatar ground.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete forever, Disconnect account) and field errors. The Failed status has its own tokens.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an error fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Destructive confirmation panels.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background and top app bar at rest.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed background behind the dry-run summary when the list scrolls under it.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Bright surface in dark theme lists; rarely used.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Inset fields inside cards (path rows).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Folder-pair cards and grouped settings blocks.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar, bottom app bar, menus.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, search field, scrolled top app bar.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, switch track (off), storage-bar track.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface and surface-container role.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, paths, inactive icons; on every surface role.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Legacy Compose role, kept for components that still read it; equals surface-container-highest.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar and tooltip ground.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons and text fields, the radio ring, the Other segment of a storage bar.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal sheets and dialogs, at 32% opacity.

tokens.name: status-synced
tokens.usage: Synced: a pair whose phone and Drive folders match. Icon cloud_done. Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-synced-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the synced status chip and the synced banner.

tokens.name: on-status-synced-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-synced-container.

tokens.name: status-syncing
tokens.usage: Syncing: work in progress, always with a progress value or "Scanning". Icon sync (turning). Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-syncing-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the syncing status chip and the syncing banner.

tokens.name: on-status-syncing-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-syncing-container.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting for Wi-Fi (also: charging, schedule, paused): held back on purpose; nothing is wrong. Icon wifi. Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-waiting-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the waiting status chip and the waiting banner.

tokens.name: on-status-waiting-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-waiting-container.

tokens.name: status-approval
tokens.usage: Needs approval: Drive Sync stopped before a risky change (a large delete, first merge) and is waiting for you. Icon front_hand. Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-approval-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the approval status chip and the approval banner.

tokens.name: on-status-approval-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-approval-container.

tokens.name: status-conflict
tokens.usage: Conflict: the same file changed on both sides; both copies are kept until you choose. Icon call_split. Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-conflict-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the conflict status chip and the conflict banner.

tokens.name: on-status-conflict-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-conflict-container.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed: could not finish (access lost, Drive full, network error). Icon error. Icon and label colour on any surface or surface-container role. Fixed: does not follow dynamic colour.

tokens.name: status-failed-container
tokens.usage: Ground of the failed status chip and the failed banner.

tokens.name: on-status-failed-container
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-failed-container.

tokens.name: storage-pair
tokens.usage: Storage bar: space this pair uses. Alias of primary.

tokens.name: storage-other
tokens.usage: Storage bar: everything else on that phone or Drive. Alias of outline; segments are separated by a 2px gap, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: storage-free
tokens.usage: Storage bar track: free space.

tokens.name: storage-low
tokens.usage: Replaces storage-pair and storage-other when less than 10% is free; the label says "Low space" too.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The logo ground (adaptive icon background) and marketing blocks. Fixed in every theme; not a UI role.

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: The logo mark on brand-green (6.3:1). Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The mark and wordmark mark on plain surfaces: brand-green on light, a light brand mint on dark. Fixed: never follows dynamic colour.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest brand ink: the mark on light grounds in print and the cover ink block. Fixed.

groups.name: Display & headline
groups.note: Sparingly: onboarding titles and the big number on the dry-run summary.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: The headline count on the dry-run summary. Tabular figures.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Large top app bar titles (collapsing), dialog titles on full-screen dialogs.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Small top app bar title; bottom-sheet titles.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Folder-pair card name, section headers in lists, dialog titles.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Sync-mode option names, group headers in Problems.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Nothing changes until you tap Start sync.
styles.usage: Primary list-item text, onboarding body, setting titles.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Supporting text: card metadata, list supporting lines, callout body.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Captions under storage bars, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Status chips, navigation-bar labels, badge text.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Overlines in path rows (PHONE / DRIVE), storage legend keys.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Paths, file names that must be exact, hashes and the diagnostics log.

styles.name: mono-medium
styles.usage: Full paths and exclude patterns in the pair editor.

spacing.note: 4dp grid. Names are the dp value, so space-16 is 16.dp in Compose.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between storage-bar segments; hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; between stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; padding inside status chips; icon-to-text in list rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between folder-pair cards; between a field and its helper text.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen side margin; card and list-item horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card internal block spacing (header → paths → storage).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Onboarding vertical rhythm; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Top padding above onboarding illustrations and empty states.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Clearance above the bottom action bar on long scrolling screens.

radius.note: Material 3 shape scale. Calm means soft: cards use shape-lg, not the M3 default 12.

tokens.name: shape-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed list rows and the top app bar.

tokens.name: shape-xs
tokens.usage: Filled text field top corners, the snackbar, tooltips.

tokens.name: shape-sm
tokens.usage: Chips (filter, status), path rows, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: shape-md
tokens.usage: Callouts and banners, menus, file thumbnails in the bin.

tokens.name: shape-lg
tokens.usage: Folder-pair cards, sync-mode option cards, the FAB.

tokens.name: shape-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets (top corners), the onboarding promise panel.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, storage bars, progress tracks, switches, the nav indicator.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare: elevation is mostly tonal (see the elevation family). Use these only where something floats.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: a dragged card, the snackbar.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: menus.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Level 3: the FAB at rest, dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and D-pad focus: a 2px surface gap, then a solid 3px secondary ring (≥3:1 on every surface).

elevation.note: Material 3 elevation levels in dp. In Compose pass tonalElevation; colour comes from the surface-container roles, not from shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Screens, list rows, folder-pair cards (they sit on surface-container-low instead).

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Snackbar, a card being dragged to reorder.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Navigation bar, menus, scrolled top app bar.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: FAB, dialogs, modal bottom sheets.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Hovered or pressed FAB.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: Not used. Reserved.

duration.note: Calm motion: short, settled, never bouncy. Respect the system Remove animations setting (all to 0, the sync icon stops turning).

tokens.name: duration-short
tokens.usage: State changes: press ripple fade, switch thumb, chip select.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Expand a card, open a menu, swap a status chip.

tokens.name: duration-long
tokens.usage: Screen transitions and bottom sheets entering.

tokens.name: duration-progress
tokens.usage: Tween between two progress values, so the bar glides instead of jumping.

tokens.name: duration-sync-turn
tokens.usage: One full turn of the syncing icon. Slow on purpose.

tokens.name: duration-snackbar-undo
tokens.usage: How long an Undo snackbar stays after a destructive action.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default for anything that stays on screen.

tokens.name: easing-decelerate
tokens.usage: Elements entering: list items appearing after a scan.

tokens.name: easing-accelerate
tokens.usage: Elements leaving: a dismissed problem, a restored bin item.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized-decelerate
tokens.usage: Screen and sheet entrances.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized-accelerate
tokens.usage: Screen and sheet exits.

tokens.name: easing-linear
tokens.usage: Only the turning sync icon and indeterminate progress.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers, drawn in the content colour over the container.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover (Chromebook, mouse).

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Focused state layer, together with focus-ring.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed (the ripple).

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged card.

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons (on-surface at 38%).

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled button fills (on-surface at 12%).

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and modal sheets.

tokens.name: size-touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable area for every control, even when the visual is smaller.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Standard icon.

tokens.name: size-icon-small
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and buttons.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Button height.

tokens.name: size-button-compact
tokens.usage: Least height of a compact action button in cards, banners and rows. A floor, never a fixed height: the label grows with the font size.

tokens.name: size-tag
tokens.usage: Least height of a tag ("Current" on a version); grows with the font size.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height; status chips are 28.

tokens.name: size-status-chip
tokens.usage: Status chip height.

tokens.name: size-app-bar
tokens.usage: Small top app bar.

tokens.name: size-nav-bar
tokens.usage: Navigation bar.

tokens.name: size-list-one-line
tokens.usage: One-line list item.

tokens.name: size-list-two-line
tokens.usage: Two-line list item (file rows, settings with summary).

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: FAB.

tokens.name: size-storage-bar
tokens.usage: Storage bar height.

tokens.name: size-progress-track
tokens.usage: Linear progress height.
